title: GuardVal: Dynamic Large Language Model Jailbreak Evaluation for Comprehensive Safety Testing

bias_targets.methodology: Dynamic generation and iterative refinement of adversarial jailbreak prompts using a multi-role attacker LLM framework (GuardVal) to measure the number of conversational rounds required to bypass the target model's safety guardrails in the 'Bias' domain.
